fields.Name: T158 - Experiments Kanban and Leaderboard
fields.Description: Exercises the PSExperiments kanban + leaderboard + budget-gauge derivations over Experiment Sessions/Iterations — a distinct visualization panel.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and select the 'Experiments' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Success is the experiment session view rendering: a session header with a status badge, a Leaderboard strip ranked by score, and a kanban with three columns (Running / Completed / Pruned) of iteration cards. If there are no experiment sessions yet, the documented empty state ('No experiment sessions yet') is also a pass. You do NOT need to launch or control an experiment.

judgeValidationCriteria: Either the session header + leaderboard strip + Running/Completed/Pruned kanban columns render, OR the 'No experiment sessions yet' empty state renders
When a session is present, the three kanban columns are each labeled and show counts
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
